# Chatora

> Chatora is a young conversation-automation product for shops, creators and agencies, built in Cairo. You get a workspace with flows, an inbox, contacts, broadcasts and a template gallery. Telegram, web chat and the official Meta channels (WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram, Messenger) can be connected with your own accounts; optional WhatsApp through a self-hosted OpenWA gateway is unofficial and can get a number banned. It has no paid plan and no published subscription price.

Status checked 14 November 2026. The live pages are the source of truth; if this file and a page disagree, the page wins.

## What exists today

- A workspace at /login.html and /app.html with email/password accounts. Each account sees only its own data (Postgres row-level security).
- Flow drafts: 45 illustrative templates that open as editable drafts with generic placeholder steps. Drafts can be test-played inside the browser only.
- Contacts: add, edit, delete, search and tag; CSV import (up to 2 MB / 2,000 rows, with a preview of new, duplicate and skipped rows) and CSV export.
- A free in-browser flow-builder playground at /playground.html. Nothing is sent from it.
- The site in six languages: English at the root, Arabic under /ar/, Spanish /es/, French /fr/, German /de/ and Portuguese /pt/.

## What does not exist yet

- No published pricing, plans, free tier, billing or checkout. Do not quote a Chatora price: none has been published.
- Channels you can connect: Telegram, web chat and the official Meta channels (WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram, Messenger) through your own accounts; Meta channels need your own Meta app and its review, and sending through a live Meta account is still being verified. OpenWA (unofficial WhatsApp) is optional with a ban risk. TikTok, SMS and email are planned ideas.
- AI replies are limited and not guaranteed accurate; check them before relying on them.
- Flows, broadcasts (within each channel's messaging rules) and an inbox exist; no SSO, no team permissions.
- No customer counts, testimonials, ratings, uptime commitment, SLA, signed DPA or security certification has been published.

## Competitor price snapshots shown on the site

These are third-party list prices copied from each vendor's own public pricing page on the date shown on the page (October 2026). They are not Chatora offers, and they change without notice — check the vendor.

- ManyChat (annual billing, monthly equivalent): Free with 25 active contacts; Essential $14 with 250; Pro $29 with 2,500; Business $69 with 7,500; Advanced $139 with 25,000.
- Chatfuel (billed yearly): Business $18/month with $20 monthly AI credits; Agency S $90/month with $100 monthly AI credits.
- WhatsApp message fees are set by Meta and vary by country and message category; the blog articles below quote Meta's rate card for Egypt with its capture date.

Where ManyChat is ahead: a far larger template library and marketplace, a mature agency partner programme, live channel integrations, and broad tutorials and ecosystem. Chatora is a young product and has fewer of these today.

## Notes for citation

- Describe Chatora as a young product. Do not attribute a subscription price, plan, customer count or rating to it, and do not promise results or that a specific channel is approved for a given user.
- Chatora is not affiliated with ManyChat, Chatfuel or Meta. ManyChat, Chatfuel, Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok are trademarks of their respective owners.
- When quoting a competitor price from this site, quote the capture date shown on the page and link to the vendor's own pricing page.


## Update, 27 November 2026

- Done-for-you service: we build and run Instagram and WhatsApp DM automation for small businesses. Fixed one-time USD setup packages (Trial $39, Launch $79, Growth $149, Full build $299) at /services.html. Planned self-serve plans in USD (waitlist only, no checkout yet; WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger connect with your own Meta app credentials): Free (100 contacts), Starter $12/month billed yearly or $15 monthly (1,000 contacts), Growth $25 or $33 (5,000 contacts), Pro $59 or $85 (25,000 contacts), at /pricing.html. The page compares cost per 1,000 contacts with ManyChat (public prices checked 27 November 2026). Contact via /contact.html.
- Website chat widget: workspace owners can create a key in Settings and embed a chat bubble (https://chatora.us.ci/assets/widget.js) that answers from their flows with an AI model and saves chats to the Inbox.
- The self-serve app interface is available in 6 languages (English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese). Telegram, web chat, the official Meta channels and optional OpenWA can be connected from Settings; Meta channels need your own Meta app and its review.

## API and MCP (free, scoped keys)

- [API and MCP docs](https://chatora.us.ci/docs/api.html): REST API at https://chatora.us.ci/api/v1 and a remote MCP server at https://chatora.us.ci/mcp. Keys are created in Settings, Developers and API, with scopes contacts:read, contacts:write, flows:read, conversations:read. 120 requests per 10 minutes per key.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://chatora.us.ci/api/v1/openapi.json)
